title: Restraint
prompt:
REFERENCE IMAGE ROLES:
— the previous frame of this storyboard. BASE IMAGE: edit it as instructed; everything the instruction does not change stays exactly as it is.
— a gold emblem on black: an open circle broken at the upper right, crossed by a level bar and a steep slanted bar that meet in a small stepped block. OBJECT REFERENCE: this is the Thoughtform brand mark. Reproduce its shape exactly.

Edit the base image. Change ONE thing: halve the amount of detail. On the left, keep the office walls and desks but show people only as single tiny bone-white dots, and remove every green tree and plant. On the right, keep fewer and cleaner gold circuit traces and only a few die blocks, with more black between them. Neither emptier than a sketch nor as busy as the base. Keep exactly: the silhouette, the drum walls, the gold crescent, the two gaps, the stepped block, the fraying at the upper left, the palette and the camera. No words or letters.
